chemical_inputs: Full parent heavy graph from pinned CCD atom/bond/formal-charge/stereo definitions and declared chemical branch links. Only pdbx_model_Cartn_{x,y,z}_ideal fields may supply monomer chemical geometry. No experimental/native ligand coordinates, ligand pose, receptor or docking box is read.
supported_ring_scope: Exactly one complete six-membered pyranose ring per component; other ring sizes or ambiguous ring identity fail explicitly. No extension to septanoses or unusual enzyme-bound puckers is inferred.
stereo_assignment: Assign each independent CCD monomer's tetrahedral tags from its chemical-ideal geometry, transfer to full connected graph with explicit leaving-atom substitution and neighbor permutation parity. Discard all monomer conformers before independent embedding. Named signed volumes and full-parent isomeric graph must survive.

constraints.embedding: All15 within-ring pair distances bounded by CCD chemical-ideal distances, with required triangle smoothing. No cross-ring distance or absolute position constraints.

selection: Evaluate every fixed candidate slot. Among converged candidates passing all gates, choose the smallest unconstrained MMFF94 energy evaluated at the constrained geometry; tie by slot index. Never select by experimental/native similarity, docking, or a desired outcome. Record every failed slot and reason; fail if no valid candidate.
coordinates_after_selection: Retain the constrained optimized conformer. No subsequent unconstrained MMFF relaxation is part of this profile. Glycosidic orientations remain independently sampled and are never fitted to native geometry.
source_math: aav_benchmark/ring_geometry.py: original Cremer-Pople equations, fixed named cyclic order. Full named pucker-vector comparison is required; nearest-chair-pole distance alone cannot distinguish opposite chairs.
interpretation: A constrained independent chemical-ideal chair initialization sensitivity. It is not a free-energy ensemble, a claim all bound sugars adopt the CCD chair, or permission to change a frozen primary preparation or run a new docking study before a separate root freeze.
development_amendment: Version1 retained20/20embeddingfailures at initial/eigenvalue or chirality stage. Version2 uses independent random-coordinate ETKDG initialization, preserving20slots/oneDGattempt per slot and every quality gate. This amendment uses physical input feasibility only, no docking or atomicaccuracy outcomes.
